facts.text: A decision gate is a planned point where management decides whether a program continues, changes course or stops; an evidence gate is a decision gate whose pass criterion is evidence obtained rather than a date reached.
facts.quote: A decision gate is a planned point at which management must decide whether a program continues, changes course or stops, and an evidence gate is a decision gate whose pass criterion is a piece of evidence obtained, not a date reached.

facts.text: Program gate pass criteria must be written and signed by the sponsor in advance, with a named decision-maker.
facts.quote: The pass criteria are written and signed by the sponsor in advance, a named person decides

facts.text: Each program gate allows at least four outcomes: go, go with restrictions, pivot to a fallback, and stop. A gate permitting only go is a review meeting rather than a decision gate.
facts.quote: each gate allows at least four outcomes: go, go with restrictions, pivot to a fallback, and stop. The booklet is blunt: "A gate that permits only go is a review meeting, not a decision gate" [Chapter 12].

facts.text: Program gate criteria are fixed in advance because people who have committed effort tend to keep bad projects alive.
facts.quote: Criteria are fixed in advance because, once people have committed effort, they tend to keep bad projects alive [Chapter 12].

facts.text: The booklet recommends four or five evidence gates rather than many administrative phases.
facts.quote: The booklet recommends four or five evidence gates rather than many administrative phases [Chapter 12].

facts.text: The proposed G0 scope and evidence plan gate is at the end of November 2026: claims and the evidence plan are agreed, long-lead orders placed, criteria signed, and the decision-maker named.
facts.quote: G0, scope and evidence plan (end of November 2026): claims and evidence plan agreed, long-lead orders placed, criteria signed, decider named.

facts.text: The proposed G1 feasibility gate is at the end of January 2027: one scenario runs end to end reproducibly under configuration control.
facts.quote: G1, feasibility (end of January 2027): one scenario runs end to end, reproducibly, under configuration control.

facts.text: The proposed G2 credibility and delivery readiness gate is in March to April 2027: a blind pilot meets pre-set metrics inside its envelope, assessor feedback has been received, and the 80 percent confidence date is inside the deadline.
facts.quote: G2, credibility and delivery readiness (March to April 2027): a blind pilot meets pre-set metrics inside its envelope, assessor feedback received, the 80 percent confidence date inside the deadline.

facts.text: The proposed G3 coverage gate is at the end of June 2027: planned coverage is reached with no open credibility defeaters on high-integrity claims.
facts.quote: G3, coverage (end of June 2027): planned coverage reached with no open credibility defeaters on high-integrity claims.

facts.text: The proposed G4 evidence release gate is in August to September 2027: the package states its envelope, limitations and residual uncertainty, and results support only the claims made. Outcomes are release, release with restrictions, or withhold.
facts.quote: G4, evidence release (August to September 2027): the package states envelope, limitations and residual uncertainty, and results support only the claims made; outcomes are release, release with restrictions, or withhold [Chapter 12].

facts.text: The release domain is widened only through an evidence gate.
facts.quote: The release domain is widened "only by evidence gate" [Chapter 1]

facts.text: The cheapest early experiments are intended to feed stage-gated funding.
facts.quote: the cheapest early experiments are meant to feed stage-gated funding [Chapter 13].

facts.text: For a program with a fixed deadline, gates prevent optimism from running ahead of evidence and make restriction or stopping legitimate decisions.
facts.quote: With a fixed deadline, gates are the mechanism that stops optimism from running ahead of evidence and makes "restrict" or "stop" legitimate answers.
